profile.headline: Associate Software Engineer at Red Hat | Former Healthcare Professional Pivoting Into Tech
profile.summary: Analytical-minded healthcare professional with a passion for learning how technology and data science can help transform and leverage better outcomes from traditional health delivery systems.

positions.title: Associate Software Engineer
positions.locationName: Durham, North Carolina, United States · Hybrid
positions.description:
I’m part of Red Hat’s Ansible Cloud Content Team, where I help design, develop, and maintain cloud-focused Ansible content, including modules, plugins, roles, and collections. My responsibilities span coding, testing, documenting, and improving automation tools used by developers and operations teams globally.

With experience transitioning from healthcare into software engineering, I’m driven by a commitment to problem-solving and building solutions that simplify complex workflows. I enjoy working with Python, cloud platforms, and open-source tooling to expand the capabilities of Ansible Automation Platform.

positions.locationName: Chapel Hill, North Carolina, United States

positions.title: Business Practice Improvement Manager
positions.description: Skills: Data Analysis · Tableau · PowerPoint · Healthcare Management

positions.title: Performance Management Consultant
positions.description:
• Managed functional transition for 100+ employees from national hospital and medical group revenue cycle clients to central business structures resulting in lowered overhead, reduced vendor reliance, and improved quality control
• Designed comprehensive enterprise-wide Revenue Integrity staffing structure resulting in projected $12M annual savings from increased collections and reduced operational write-offs
• Developed hiring monitoring tool used for tracking over 1,000 positions for centralized revenue cycle functions resulting in improved executive insight and targeted recruitment
• Analyzed accounts receivable in excess of $5M for operational write-offs for several hospitals in system resulting in improved budgeting
• Led internal work groups across enterprise focused on enhancing revenue streams via quality improvement, right-sizing, and engagement with employees
• Authored Standard Operating Procedure (SOP) manuals for enterprise-wide Charge Review and Hospital Billing Workqueue Management processes within the Epic EMR which are actively referred to by over 500 billing staff
positions.insights: Skills: Data Analysis · Tableau · PowerPoint · Healthcare Management

positions.title: Business Analyst
positions.description:
Revenue Cycle Analytics
• Performed comprehensive revenue cycle analysis for multiple specialties (OBGYN, Pediatrics, Ophthalmology, Palliative, Internal Medicine, etc.) utilizing SAP Business Objects for Epic data querying paired alongside Tableau and Excel for analysis.
• Developed dashboards in Tableau that are utilized across the enterprise (Open Encounters, E&M distributions, Specialty-specific data dashboards, etc.).
• Worked closely with billing services departments to catch high-value errors and enact meaningful change in Epic logic to ensure constant improvement in all revenue cycle key performance indicators (KPIs).
• Presented findings on a regular basis for physicians, administrators, and practice managers from each department. Led additional working meetings where all stakeholders engaged in efforts to improve operations in order to positively affect collection rates and reduce back-end work from billing department.
positions.insights: Skills: Data Analysis · Tableau · PowerPoint · Healthcare Management

company.name: The University of Texas Medical Branch at Galveston

positions.title: Manager, Project Development & Support
positions.description:
• Developed prototype dashboards for clinical departments in Microsoft PowerBI utilizing data housed in Microsoft SQL Server Analysis Services to track access, volume, and performance metrics.
• Designed medical scribe scenario analysis to test options for hiring medical scribes, complete with estimated revenues and editable assumption fields leading to hiring an additional 10+ scribes across the faculty group.
• Liaisoned with clinical, research, and academic administration teams regarding faculty staffing plans for each fiscal year and track hire progress.
• Utilized Sg2 Analytics platform to perform market analysis of local stroke center competition and patient demand and provided recommendations to leadership for hiring specific providers to achieve Comprehensive Stroke Status designation.
• Awarded $30,000 grant for the creation, implementation, and management of baby box distribution program which gives out nearly 6,000 boxes per year to underserved families who greatly benefit from a safe sleep resource for their newborn.
• Managed, developed KPIs for, and regularly updated strategic scorecards that tie into executive incentives and overall future planning for the university.

positions.title: Administrative Fellow
positions.description:
• Authored business plan for a $1 million joint-Neurology/Pain Management clinic that was inclusive of design blueprints, equipment, staffing models, and justification leading to a build-out after presenting to leadership.
• Helped lead a Radiology process improvement team with the task of reducing the turn-around time of MRI “order to schedule” cycles and implement pilot phase of nurse workstation screensaver notifications in order to hasten patient imaging process.
• Assisted with the coordination, planning, and transfer of eight individual inpatient units, totaling over 100 staff, from a temporary location back to their original location after emergency circumstances.
• Interpreted and assimilated multiple insurance Shared Savings Programs’ requirements and metrics into scorecards and assisted with the implementation of an ACO-like model across ambulatory clinics with a combined patient population of 27,000.

positions.title: Administrative Intern
positions.description:
• Designed an Excel scorecard that allowed Environmental and Nutrition Services to track their patient satisfaction scores with automated trending graphs for each measure.
• Tracked and analyzed staff parking garage utilization and provided hospital leadership with recommendations to alleviate early morning parking delays.
• Assisted with creation of hospital infection control quality policies and the rollout of an employee recycling program.
positions.insights: Skills: Data Analysis · PowerPoint · Healthcare Management

positions.title: Long Term Care Intern
positions.description:
• Built a custom Excel patient tracker/validator tool for the readmission prevention team to track hundreds of patients at seven external long-term care (skilled nursing) facilities in order to prevent dozens of unnecessary readmissions.
• Coordinated all data collection, analysis, and reporting used to meet project team quarterly goals.

volunteerExperiences.description: Serve on the board and advise on all things social media. Produce content for our social channels on a regular basis.
